title: RNL standard word list
description: Structure of the RNL standard word list (rnl-words-<version>.json, section 5.3 of the standard).

kinds.description: Kind names, used in signatures and in role declarations (5.3, 9.4).

pseudo_kinds.description: Names used only in slot signatures; not standard words.

takes.description: What a slot takes (5.2.1); explanation of the values of slot.takes.

style_groups.description: Groups of style properties that keywords take as parameters (9.2.5).

since.description: The language version that added the word (16.1).

type.description: terminal: a terminal number from 1, or a terminal name (6.4); color: "#RRGGBB".

items.description: What the items of an array are. A parameter of another type that has items also takes a non-empty array of such values (PIN terminal, 9.2.4).

name.description: Slot name; it can be written as a role (5.3).

kinds.description: Kind names or pseudo-kinds; for a definition slot: general, symbol or style.

mode.description: Consumption mode (5.4): absorbed input is strict, enclosed input tolerant (7.3).

at.description: Where the definition slot is written (5.6).

where.description: level: any record of a level; symbol: a DEFINE-SYMBOL body; header: header records only; package-header: the header record of a package file only.

role_slots.description: AS, ATTACH: the other slots are the roles of the general definition (9.4).

definition_params.description: AS, ATTACH: the parameters of the general definition are accepted too (9.4).

style.description: A style group whose properties are parameters too; all: every style property (DEFINE-STYLE).

positional.description: Parameters that can be given by position, in this order; the others only by name (4.2).

together.description: Parameters given all together or not at all.

exclusive.description: Parameters that cannot be given together.

shape_params.description: Given: the slot takes the centre point; not given: a set of points (9.2.5).

output.description: none: no handle; same: the handle of the input; target: the handle of the target set; new: a new object; definition: a definition.

rewrites.description: The kind of object that, given alone in the first slot, the statement rewrites instead of making a new object; the rewrite overrides by key, the object (5.8, 13.1). The slot takes it only alone, never in a set, besides the kinds it lists.

selects.description: Selections: the kind of the members of the resulting set.

key_subobject.description: TEXT: with key=, the text is a sub-object of the object it is attached to (13.3).

override.description: How facts override (5.8); absent: facts accumulate. geometry: geometric facts, resolved by priority and position (8.5); queue: the appearance queue (8.3).

key.description: What the key of the fact is.

form.description: The standard form (4.3): slots in braces, positional parameters by name.

sentence.description: A standard sentence (4.5, Annex B); informative.
